{
  "candidate_rtl": "`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module pw_crc32_d8 (
    input  wire [7:0]  data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0]  data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    // Combine the corresponding data and CRC bits before the CRC matrix.
    wire [7:0] t;
    assign t = data_in ^ state_in[7:0];

    // Constant elaboration-time matrix construction.  Entries represent
    // coefficients of t, not hardware storage or runtime iteration.
    function [7:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [7:0] s [0:31];
        reg [7:0] feedback;
        reg [31:0] polynomial;
        integer i, j;
        begin
            polynomial = 32'hedb88320;
            crc_mask = 8'b0;
            for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1) begin
                s[j] = 8'b0;
                if (j < 8)
                    s[j] = 8'b00000001 << j;
            end
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                feedback = s[0];
                if (index == 32+i)
                    crc_mask = feedback;
                for (j = 0; j < 31; j = j + 1)
                    s[j] = s[j+1];
                s[31] = 8'b0;
                for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                    if (polynomial[j])
                        s[j] = s[j] ^ feedback;
            end
            if (index < 32)
                crc_mask = s[index];
        end
    endfunction

    function integer population;
        input [7:0] mask;
        integer j;
        begin
            population = 0;
            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1)
                population = population + mask[j];
        end
    endfunction

    function integer prefix_population;
        input [7:0] mask;
        input integer limit;
        integer j;
        begin
            prefix_population = 0;
            for (j = 0; j < limit; j = j + 1)
                prefix_population = prefix_population + mask[j];
        end
    endfunction

    wire [39:0] result;
    genvar n, b;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 40; n = n + 1) begin : output_matrix
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            localparam integer TERMS = population(MASK);
            localparam integer SHIFT_TERM = (n < 24) ? 1 : 0;
            localparam integer N = TERMS + SHIFT_TERM;
            if (N == 0) begin : constant_output
                assign result[n] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : parity_output
                wire [N-1:0] leaves;
                for (b = 0; b < 8; b = b + 1) begin : select_term
                    if (MASK[b]) begin : selected
                        localparam integer POSITION = prefix_population(MASK, b);
                        assign leaves[POSITION] = t[b];
                    end
                end
                if (n < 24) begin : shifted_state
                    assign leaves[TERMS] = state_in[n+8];
                end
                pw_crc32_d8_parity #(.N(N)) parity (
                    .x(leaves),
                    .y(result[n])
                );
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign state_out = result[31:0];
    assign data_out = result[39:32];
endmodule

module pw_crc32_d8_parity #(
    parameter integer N = 1
) (
    input  wire [N-1:0] x,
    output wire y
);
    generate
        if (N == 1) begin : leaf
            assign y = x[0];
        end else begin : branch
            localparam integer L = N/2;
            localparam integer R = N-L;
            wire yl, yr;
            pw_crc32_d8_parity #(.N(L)) left_tree (
                .x(x[L-1:0]), .y(yl)
            );
            pw_crc32_d8_parity #(.N(R)) right_tree (
                .x(x[N-1:L]), .y(yr)
            );
            assign y = yl ^ yr;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

`default_nettype wire
",
  "bottleneck": "The original independently reduces expanded state/data masks. Corresponding low-state and data bits occur together throughout these masks, creating redundant XOR work and potentially unfavorable mapped parity depth.",
  "rewrite": "Factor the eight common expressions t[i] = data_in[i] XOR state_in[i]. Construct the reflected CRC-32 byte-update matrix at elaboration time using polynomial 0xEDB88320. Implement each output using a compact, explicitly balanced parity tree containing only its contributing terms. Include the shifted upper-state bit directly in that tree. Construct data_out from the eight actual feedback expressions rather than passing data_in through.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce redundant parity logic and improve maximum arrival time through shared input factoring and balanced trees. No numeric SKY130HD timing improvement is claimed without mapping and STA; synthesis may restructure the trees.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Eight shared input XORs feed the matrix, replacing repeated state/data contributions. This should reduce XOR count relative to independently expanded masks, although fanout buffering can offset some savings. Compliance with the 2719.608320 um2 cap and electrical limits requires evaluation in the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the fixed, parameterless pw_crc32_d8 interface, unsigned port widths, combinational behavior, and zero latency. Both outputs retain the reflected Galois CRC behavior for arbitrary binary state_in and data_in, without initialization assumptions or final inversion. Helper recursion and matrix arrays are elaboration-time constructs; there are no runtime memories, latches, clocks, resets, assertions, or undefined outputs. Equivalence and physical checks have not been run here."
}
